items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And there was another one named Alice Jackson, I think, yeah, Alice Jackson.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the singers there, who they were?

Yes, there was a woman called Mabel Richardson. She was from Washington or Baltimore. She was very good. And there was another one named Alice Jackson, I think, yeah, Alice Jackson. And there was nobody, of course, the ones that you would know more than her, but she was working more with Madison Reed, but that was Mary Stafford, she was with him. Mabel Richardson was almost as good as Mary Stafford, though. And there was another woman called Teddy Peters from out in Chicago, I mean, out along the coast. I asked…
